headline: 1.6 crore families to get Family Card rollout launched August 16
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will officially launch the programme in Kishoreganj, with plans to expand coverage to 16 million families over four years.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will officially launch the Family Card programme for the current fiscal year on August 16 at ward 8 of Latifabad union in Kishoreganj Sadar upazila.
Social Welfare Minister Prof Dr AZM Zahid Hossain announced the announcement following a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Family Cards, chaired by Finance Minister Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury.
The government plans to expand the programme to nearly 1.6 crore families over the next four years, with 41 lakh beneficiaries already provided for in the current fiscal year's budget.

To ensure accuracy, a 'Dynamic Social Registry' system has been introduced. This system allows for continuous updates of beneficiaries' information to reflect changes in their socioeconomic conditions.
The minister also stated that verification will be conducted at the union level to eliminate flaws in the distribution process and ensure no eligible person is left out.
caption:
1.6 crore families will receive Family Cards over the next four years. The official rollout begins August 16.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will officially launch the Family Card programme for the current fiscal year on August 16 at ward 8 of Latifabad union in Kishoreganj Sadar upazila.

Social Welfare Minister Prof Dr AZM Zahid Hossain announced the announcement following a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Family Cards, chaired by Finance Minister Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury.

The government plans to expand the programme to nearly 1.6 crore families over the next four years, with 41 lakh beneficiaries already provided for in the current fiscal year's budget.

To ensure accuracy, a 'Dynamic Social Registry' system has been introduced. This system allows for continuous updates of beneficiaries' information to reflect changes in their socioeconomic conditions.

The minister also stated that verification will be conducted at the union level to eliminate flaws in the distribution process and ensure no eligible person is left out.

headline: EC: Presidential election on August 20
summary: The Election Commission has announced the schedule for the presidential election, with polling to take place from 2:00pm to 5:00pm.
details: The Election Commission (EC) has announced that the presidential election will be held on August 20, with polling scheduled from 2:00pm to 5:00pm.
Nomination papers must be submitted on August 13 between 10:00am and 4:00pm, with the scrutiny of nomination papers beginning on August 16.
EC Senior Secretary Akhtar Ahmed announced the schedule this afternoon at the commission's headquarters in Agargaon, Dhaka.
The schedule was announced in accordance with the Presidential Election Act, 1991, following consultations between the chief election commissioner and the Speaker of parliament.
The EC has already received the electoral roll comprising 349 members of parliament from the Parliament Secretariat.
The commission has held a meeting to finalise preparations and will complete the remaining administrative procedures in line with the announced schedule.
caption:

EC Senior Secretary Akhtar Ahmed announced the schedule this afternoon at the commission's headquarters in Agargaon, Dhaka.

The schedule was announced in accordance with the Presidential Election Act, 1991, following consultations between the chief election commissioner and the Speaker of parliament.

The EC has already received the electoral roll comprising 349 members of parliament from the Parliament Secretariat.
